scripts.clean: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-integration', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && node --test "dist/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:integration: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "dist-integration/**/*.test.js"
